source.title: 诊断学（第10版）
source.section: 第五篇 辅助检查 第一章 心电图 第七节

textbook_summary: P disappearance may coexist with continuing sinus drive; absent P must not automatically label sinus arrest.

notes: Same highK conduction QRS/ST/T, ventricular and respiratory clocks; explicit absence of effective atrial excitation/contraction; no concentration or cell-level model.

PR: not measurable/applicable; stored PR field is structural source offset only
P_bands: removed, not just hidden by display or gain
limitations: One authored absentP mechanism, not all causes
No sinus/internodal electrophysiology or escape diagnosis
No sine-wave fusion or R/S voltage remodelling
